theorem_statement: Within the 144-cycle third-order frontier, registered ten-cycles are exactly those with no fully external four-step bridge returning at cycle distance four or five. Every nonregistered frontier cycle has exactly sixteen such bridges, split eight near-antipodal and eight antipodal.

interpretation.earned: The fourth-order deficit is now localized to a concrete external bridge family rather than a spectral or walk-count difference.
interpretation.next_frontier: The mediator census determines whether the sixteen bridges are generated by one compact absent matching or relay set.
